scope: Repair the EG1 three-process TEST FIXTURE one-shot unreliable delivery assumption. No production network/runtime mutation, no acceptance or MVP dispatch. Existing original 33 domain/identity/ledger assertions remain unchanged.
required_outputs: Minimal test-only patch and deterministic negative/positive evidence
Exact CI logs and all child reports
Separate independent role results and human merge request
notes: Bounded test-only repair continuation under the existing closure mission, not a production execution activation or mutation lease. Main runtime authority remains false. This record remains immutable; execution facts are appended separately.

design_brief.problem_statement: EG1 sends one INPUT and one SNAPSHOT over UNRELIABLE_SEQUENCED, then requires all four logical results without recovery. Dropping exactly the first INPUT reproduces the observed three-operation timeout.
design_brief.current_behavior: Native CI can lose the single movement/snapshot datagram, making the composition fixture fail nondeterministically despite valid transport behavior.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Test workers send a fixed finite set of identical physical copies for unreliable fixture frames; existing canonical receive-boundary deduplication still admits each logical operation only once. Persistent loss and real send errors still fail.
alternatives_considered: Switch INPUT/SNAPSHOT to reliable transport: rejected, changes exercised protocol
Retry the whole suite until green: rejected
Fixed bounded physical redundancy inside test fixtures only
design_brief.selected_design: A test-only ENet port subclass repeats identical validated unreliable wire frames a fixed number of times at fixed intervals, with bounded queue and explicit errors. Production port, boundary, gateway and domain service are unchanged. Add deterministic receive-loss injection only for verification cases.
design_brief.why_selected: Preserves real ENet, physical channels/modes, all original canonical equivalence/unique operation assertions, and existing dedup owner without pretending unreliable transport guarantees delivery.
dependencies: Existing canonical UNRELIABLE_SEQUENCED receive-boundary duplicate suppression
non_goals: Canonical P7 acceptance without human decision
expected_risks: Copies must not cross sessions or mask genuine send errors
All-loss path must remain bounded failure
Fixture redundancy is not proof of general product loss recovery
validation_plan: First INPUT/SNAPSHOT loss per hop with original domain assertions
Fresh exact independent review and verification
